raw_text: "A5 — Workspace doctor rejects app-prod workspaces" No app production service should not run or work with workspaces.

expectation: App production nodes cannot own, consume, inspect, diagnose, or mutate workspace state through direct or indirect command families.

protection.rejected_example: An app-prod node uses a legacy grant or an indirect process, PHP, database, proxy, app, doctor, or Agent IDE alias to inspect or mutate a workspace.
protection.accepted_example: Explicit workspace aliases fail before effects, broad reads omit workspace facts, production doctor filters them, and app-prod activation fails while ownership remains.
